technobuzz.name: TechnoBuzz
technobuzz.scope: Software development, web design, cloud infrastructure, network architecture, cybersecurity, and managed IT support.
technobuzz.examples_1star: buggy deployments or broken code, critical downtime due to poor infrastructure planning, missed project deadlines, lack of communication from the support team, security vulnerabilities left unpatched, unprofessional conduct or incompetence
technobuzz.examples_2star: slow response to support tickets, complex UI/UX in web design
technobuzz.examples_3star: technical team is skilled but the project management is disorganized, billing confusion or slow response
technobuzz.examples_4star: better documentation, more frequent status updates
technobuzz.examples_5star: seamless cloud migration, reliable network uptime, intuitive design interface, proactive security measures, knowledgeable engineering team, project delivered ahead of schedule

boardwale.name: Boardwale
boardwale.scope: 3D signage, indoor boards, outdoor boards, custom business signage solutions, printing, finishing, and installation.
boardwale.examples_1star: poor material quality, delayed installation, spelling errors on prints, peeling signs, unresponsive customer service
boardwale.examples_2star: incorrect colors used, rough finishing on edges, slow communication
boardwale.examples_3star: design is good but installation was messy, decent boards but pricing was confusing
boardwale.examples_4star: better communication during the design phase, faster installation
boardwale.examples_5star: excellent 3D signage quality, professional finishing, on-time installation, great custom design, high-quality materials, team understood requirements perfectly

jawa_showroom.name: Jawa Showroom
jawa_showroom.scope: Jawa motorcycle showroom and dealership experience including showroom experience, motorcycle consultation, sales support, test rides, purchase assistance, finance/EMI assistance, booking, delivery and customer service.
jawa_showroom.examples_1star: rude sales executives, terrible customer service, bikes unavailable for test ride, extremely delayed delivery, finance team was unhelpful, zero product knowledge
jawa_showroom.examples_2star: showroom was too crowded and disorganized, sales staff ignored us for a long time, booking process was confusing, test ride was rushed
jawa_showroom.examples_3star: average experience, staff was polite but didn't know much about the bike specs, delivery took longer than promised but the bike is good
jawa_showroom.examples_4star: great test ride experience, helpful staff during the finance process, good overall showroom ambiance, just a slight delay in paperwork
jawa_showroom.examples_5star: excellent dealership experience, very knowledgeable and polite sales executives, smooth EMI and exchange process, fantastic test ride arrangements, memorable delivery ceremony

rutuja_battery.name: Rutuja Battery
rutuja_battery.scope: Battery retail, inverter battery and automotive battery sales and service business in Dhayari and Manaji Nagar, Pune. Authorized Exide dealer offering two-wheeler, car, and commercial vehicle batteries, inverter/UPS batteries, installation, replacement, testing, jump-start assistance, and warranty support.
rutuja_battery.examples_1star: poor service, delayed installation, overpriced, sold a faulty battery, communication issues, unhelpful staff, ignored warranty claims
rutuja_battery.examples_2star: mixed experience, battery is fine but installation was delayed, average product, communication could be better, wait time was high
rutuja_battery.examples_3star: service is okay, pricing is slightly higher, installation was quick but staff could be more professional
rutuja_battery.examples_4star: good battery life, prompt service, helpful staff for battery checkup, reasonable prices
rutuja_battery.examples_5star: excellent and fast installation, very reliable service, best prices in the area, very polite staff, great after-sales support

wada_misal.name: Wada Misal
wada_misal.scope: Authentic Maharashtrian restaurant serving Misal Pav, Vada Pav, Poha, tea, and other traditional snacks. Dine-in, takeaway, and family-friendly eating experience.
wada_misal.examples_1star: terrible taste, very unhygienic place, slow service, cold food, found a bug in my misal, rude waiters
wada_misal.examples_2star: misal was too spicy with no flavor, pav was stale, tables were dirty, too crowded and noisy
wada_misal.examples_3star: average misal, nothing special. quantity is less for the price. okay for a quick snack
wada_misal.examples_4star: good authentic taste, nice ambiance, service was quick, clean environment
wada_misal.examples_5star: best misal in town, absolutely delicious and spicy! very hygienic, great family place, fast and polite service, definitely coming back
